data.title: Tax - As-Is (as documented in the Tax SOPs, the reviewed current-state maps and the group tax reporting GSOP / training)
data.chainlabel: WHT runs from the P2P invoice to the monthly ATO remittance and the annual return; CIT from the R2R close through Deloitte's computation, CFO approval, filing and payment to the return-to-provision; VAT from the P2P and O2C postings through the monthly Deloitte Vietnam return, CFC / CFO approval, e-tax filing and payment; group tax reporting runs quarterly in the TRT with the SAP pushdown after Q3
data.asisnote: As documented in the Australia WHT and AU10 CIT SOPs, the Vietnam VAT SOP (current-state maps reviewed Sep 2026), GSOP 8.6.1.95 SAP pushdown and the TDT prior year adjustment training; no pain points are recorded against Tax in the register extract

procs.name: Flow 1 - Quarterly CIT reporting calculation in the TRT
inbox: Quarter end: TRT data collection opens (Q1–Q4)
procs.outdoc: CIT reporting balances posted in ERH before the WD8 lock
procs.outnote: Current and deferred tax provision, ERH postings and tax disclosures for the press release and Annual Report; Tier 3 = PBT x statutory rate plus estimated permanent differences, Tier 4 = PBT x statutory rate

steps.t: ERH PBT and cash tax feed into the TRT
steps.d: Direct data feed of ERH profit before tax (excluding dividends) and cash tax payments / refunds into the Tax Reporting Tool for each entity.
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - overview

steps.d: Tier 3 entities (supported by TDT) also need forecast PBT and permanent differences; Tier 4 is PBT x statutory rate only.
steps.sys: GFR briefing note - Tier 3 and 4 list
steps.yes: Step 2 - input forecast PBT and permanent differences
steps.no: Tier 4 - step 3, the TRT calculates from the ERH feed
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - tiered approach

steps.t: Input forecast PBT and permanent differences
steps.d: At Q1 (no RTP yet) TDT estimates the full-year forecast PBT and the statutory-to-tax permanent differences from the prior year (NA1101 report) and enters them in the NA1201 data collection form; updated again in the quarter an RTP is processed.
steps.sys: TRT (LongView) - NA1101 report, NA1201 data collection
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - Tier 3 input at Q1 and once RTP received

steps.d: The TRT applies the statutory corporation tax rate to the year-to-date PBT and the gross temporary and permanent differences, calculating the provision by entity, the ERH postings and the tax disclosures.
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - approach for group tax reporting

steps.t: Regional lead review and confirmation to Group Tax
steps.d: The TDT regional lead reviews the input and confirms to Group Tax each quarter that forecast PBT and permanent items have been entered; Tier 3 quarterly questionnaires completed (any YES raised with Group Tax).
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - things to raise with Group Tax

steps.d: Group Tax reviews the CIT reporting calculations input into the TRT for each unit; a unit with material adjustments is rejected in the TRT and must be updated and re-signed before the WD8 lock.
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.2
steps.ctl: Unit sign-off in the TRT per Tier

steps.d: Following Group Tax's final review, material adjustments send the unit back to the preparer in the TRT.
steps.yes: Unit rejected in the TRT - update the calculation and re-sign off before the WD8 lock
steps.no: Step 6 - Group Tax posts the balances into ERH
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.2

steps.t: Post tax balances into ERH and reconcile to the TRT
steps.d: Group Tax posts all Tier 2, 3 and 4 (and most Tier 1) CIT reporting balances directly into ERH at group adjustment level before the WD8 lock and reconciles all CIT balances in the TRT with ERH.
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.3
out: Tax balances in ERH before WD8 lock

procs.name: Flow 2 - Prior year adjustments (RTP) into the TRT
procs.owner: Tax (TDT) with Deloitte (OSP), Controlling and Group Tax
inbox: CIT return filed - Deloitte RTP template available on Intela
procs.outdoc: Prior year adjustments and updated ETR in the TRT
procs.outnote: Current and deferred tax trued up to the filed return; Tier 3 permanent differences updated from the RTP; confirmation to Group Tax

steps.d: Once the tax return is filed Deloitte calculates the prior year adjustments from TRT year-end information and completes the RTP template (Summary, RTP P&L, RTP BS and TDT Summary tabs) on Intela.
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - changes from EY to Deloitte

steps.d: The prior year adjustment calculation file is reviewed by the controllers for the unit before TDT processes it.
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - what has not changed

steps.q: Return filed by the 15th of the quarter month?
steps.d: Q1–Q3: the prior year adjustment is input in the quarter if the return was filed by the 15th of the quarter month, otherwise next quarter; Q4: if filed by 31 December.
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - timing rule

steps.d: TDT inputs the current tax prior year adjustment from the TDT Summary tab (Table 3) into the TRT, following the Tier 3 process mapping tables (PYA current tax tab).
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - PYA current tax

steps.d: TDT inputs the deferred tax prior year adjustment from Table 1 (P&L) and Table 2 (OCI / Equity) into the TRT (PYA deferred tax tab of the mapping tables).
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - PYA deferred tax

steps.t: Update Tier 3 permanent differences from the RTP
steps.d: For Tier 3 entities the current-year ETR estimate is refreshed from the Deloitte RTP P&L tab (current tax per the submitted CIT return) in the NA1201 data collection form.
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - Tier 3 input once RTP template received

steps.d: The TDT regional lead checks the input against the RTP Summary sheet, the TARF report and the NA1602 (current) and NA1301 (deferred) reports in the TRT, and confirms the quarter's RTPs to Group Tax.
steps.sys: TRT - TARF, NA1602, NA1301; email to gtr@astrazeneca.com
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - review and confirmation
steps.ctl: Regional lead review; quarterly confirmation to Group Tax

steps.d: Raise with Group Tax: two returns for the same entity in one year; total PYA over USD 2m; figures in Table 2 OCI / Equity; deferred tax 'other' PYA over USD 1m gross; any YES on the Tier 3 questionnaire; unusual situations.
steps.no: No flag - prior year adjustment complete
steps.src: TDT training - input of prior year adjustments into the Tax Reporting Tool (May 2023); Tier 3 and 4 CIT reporting SOPs - things to raise with Group Tax

procs.name: Flow 3 - SAP pushdown of CIT reporting balances (8.6.1.95)
procs.owner: Tax (TDT) / Embedded Finance / GFS Middle and Back Office with Group Tax
inbox: Q3 press release: October Briefing Note instructs the SAP pushdown
procs.outdoc: CIT reporting balances reflected in the local SAP ledger
procs.outnote: Q3 journal posted at October month-end (November if missed, never as a resubmission); optional additional Q4 journal in period 13/14 after the February Briefing Note where statutory accounts need it

steps.t: Briefing Note instruction to book SAP journals
steps.d: Following the Q3 financial announcement Group Tax instructs, via the October Briefing Note, that the Q3 CIT tax postings be pushed down into SAP at October month-end; the February Briefing Note covers the optional additional Q4 journal in period 13/14.
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - tasks 8.6.1.95.4 and .14

steps.t: Extract the suggested SAP journal and TARF from the TRT
steps.d: In the TRT (Data Collection > Journals > Tax Journal Entry) select the ERH entity; the TRT compares the LongView tax balances with the unit's LOCTOT values and calculates the journal required, exported to Excel; the CC1601AZ Tax Account Rollforward (TARF) report is exported to PDF.
steps.o: Tax (TDT) / Embedded Finance / GFS MO / BO
steps.sys: TRT (LongView) - Tax Journal Entry, TARF CC1601AZ; Excel
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.5

steps.t: Inform local finance and obtain confirmation
steps.d: For Tier 3 and 4 units TDT provides local finance with the proposed SAP journal and the TARF and obtains their approval; for Tier 2 units Embedded Finance extracts the journal and TARF directly.
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.6
out: Proposed journal and TARF for approval

steps.d: Local finance disagrees with the journal, a suggested SAP account is closed, or an alternative journal is needed for a specific reason.
steps.o: Tax (TDT) / Embedded Finance / GFS MO / BO
steps.yes: Email Group Tax (gtr@) with the difference and reasoning before posting
steps.no: Step 4 - post the journal as proposed
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.7

steps.t: Create the manual journal in SAP via BlackLine
steps.d: Post the journal through the standard BlackLine journal process (8.3.2.23) with the local finance confirmation, the TRT journal file and the TARF attached; header 'Tax pushdown Q3 <year>', reason code General Tax, document type SA, accounts and posting keys per the TRT proposal.
steps.o: Embedded Finance / GFS MO / BO / Tax (TDT)
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.8
out: Tax pushdown journal at October month-end
steps.ctl: FSC006-011 - journals accurate, valid and supported

steps.t: Reconcile SAP balance sheet to the TARF
steps.d: Reconcile the SAP tax accounts (26310100 deferred tax liability, 14600100 deferred tax asset, 22340120 corporation tax payable, 17140100 corporation tax receivable) to the corresponding TARF accounts using the TARF-to-ERH-to-SAP mapping; issues sent to Group Tax.
steps.o: Embedded Finance / GFS MO / BO / Tax (TDT)
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.9

steps.t: Group Tax reconciles ERH to the TARF
steps.d: After October month-end Group Tax reconciles BS18 and PL01 in ERH at LOCTOT with the TARF report and feeds back any issues before the end of November month-end so corrections can be made.
steps.src: GSOP 8.6.1.95 Perform tax reporting SAP pushdown v1.1 (Jul 2024) - task 8.6.1.95.10
